recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-14222 unless a future work group decision changes RESTful Meta handling semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-14222 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core HTTP issue for STU3. It asked that the Resource metadata table say what servers are allowed or required to do for each Meta field, especially that servers ignore client-supplied meta.versionId/meta.lastUpdated and supply correct server values, with a note for systems that do not support versioning.
initial_application: The Jira comment records svn revision 14190. Commit 08f6c3eb5eabae98782de609be417658de92172b applied that revision by adding RESTful API behavior notes to source/resource/resource-notes.xml and adding an HTTP versioning note. Commit 5cc29abbe88aa6257c3af53138e73dfd9e478977 immediately corrected the HTTP typo from systems that do support versioning to systems that do not support versioning.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini keeps Resource in active build scope. Later related decisions refined but did not reverse this behavior: FHIR-17865 clarified Meta.lastUpdated wording, FHIR-29685 replaced write-operation links with explicit create/update/patch wording, FHIR-11259 clarified no-version server behavior for meta.versionId, and FHIR-45047 updated Meta.lastUpdated datatype comments. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/resource/resource-notes.xml still contains per-field RESTful API handling for versionId, lastUpdated, source, profile, security, and tag; source/datatypes/meta.xml and source/http.html remain consistent with those rules.

Clarified versionId behavior for servers without versioning support and keeps the current FHIR-14222 no-version wording coherent; already represented on the combined branch.
Updated Meta.lastUpdated datatype comments while preserving server-populated/possibly-out-of-sync semantics; already represented on the combined branch.
